sentence: This project sets up a center that uses advanced medical imaging technology to carry out cancer research.
This project combines causal inference and artificial intelligence methods with health records to build models that improve outcomes of antiretroviral therapy for people with HIV.
This project supports a laboratory that provides facilities for research on emerging pathogens.
This project studies which traits of T cell receptors help T cells respond to immunotherapy in pancreatic cancer.
This project offers research in cellular and molecular biology.
This project studies what causes cells to differ in how well they find and break down faulty RNA that carries nonsense mutations.
This project provides computing, bioinformatics and statistics support so researchers can study large omics datasets about health and disease.
This project tries to find out how a protein enters cancer cells and signals, to overcome immunotherapy resistance in cancer that has spread.
This project builds a model of long-lasting muscle loss injury in middle-aged mice and studies nerve and muscle problems using imaging and transcriptomics.
This project uses gene editing and RNA sequencing in vocal fold cells called fibroblasts to look for genetic targets that could reduce vocal fold scarring.
This project tests a family-based program to help youth at risk of suicide attend community mental health care after an emergency department visit.
This project builds an imaging method to see the acidity inside tumor cells and outside them, to better understand why cancer resists therapy.
This project studies how bacteria protect themselves from phage infection and how DNA methylation is controlled in humans.
This project tests a vaccine in dogs with oral melanoma to learn about virus-based immunotherapy.
This project tries to find out how influenza A virus blocks interferon production even though many of its copies fail.
This project tests thousands of chemicals, including mixtures, to find which ones affect brain development.
This project studies how a small RNA molecule affects B cells and drives autoimmune responses and lupus nephritis.
This project tests whether bacteriophage, viruses that kill bacteria, delivered from biodegradable microspheres can treat Staphylococcus aureus infections on orthopaedic devices.
This project studies how cells build their membranes and how the membranes get their mix of lipid and protein molecules.
This project tests whether a type of metabotropic glutamate receptor on certain neurons in the prefrontal cortex causes thinking problems after adolescent cocaine exposure.
